g.text: All five points: review 0 / 5 / 10 / 20 / 30% of each original S pool; panels inherit the global ranking.
Dashed lines: within-panel, same-count random-review expectations; no interval or risk guarantee.
Previously used development patients; native labels unchanged; not conformal prediction (CP).
Pressure: every original S is false-S; score-based and same-count random curves overlap.
